card.name: Linking words before a rate or limit
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as as, than, is, of or in right before a dose amount, rate or frequency limit. Seen after phrases like no more, maximum dosing frequency, at a rate.

modes.label: Rate or frequency wording
modes.description: The word after rate or frequency, just before the amount per time.
modes.example: The maximum recommended dosing frequency<< is>> once per day.

modes.label: Unit or quantity setups
modes.description: Linking or measure words in formulas and cost examples before a unit or value.

card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a dose amount, rate or limit is stated, such as the 'than' in 'no more than'.
